name: effb0-ens5-v1
architecture: EfficientNet-B0 (timm efficientnet_b0.ra_in1k), deep ensemble of 5 seeds
band_target: leukemic miss rate <= 2% on validation subjects

metrics.split: validation (18 subjects); test set not yet evaluated
metrics.band_crossfit_method: nested: temperature and band both fitted on 2/3 of validation subjects, scored on the other 1/3, same folds

disclaimer: Research demo. Not for clinical use.
source_note: Exported before the repository had commits. The export code is in commit 956490a; the ONNX file is identified by onnx_sha256.
